The default decision is to report edgeR quasi-likelihood as the primary test and use DESeq2 Wald plus limma-voom as sensitivity analyses.

~~~{r}
# Uncomment after enabling the DE targets in _targets.R
# edger_fit <- tar_read(edger_fit)
# de <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(edger_fit$fit, coef = 2)
# edgeR::topTags(de)
~~~

Use a predefined contrast, report effect sizes and FDR, and retain the full result table. Significance-only tables are for display, not for reanalysis.
